question: Which of the following is the most appropriate title for the passage?

options.text: Cybersecurity Measures for Individuals and Organisations
Types of Cybercrime and Their Effects
The Role of Governments in Combatting Cybercrime

solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 3.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage defines cybercrime and discusses various types **(hacking, phishing, ransomware, identity theft)** and their impacts. 
 
• It mentions measures to combat cybercrime but focuses more on explaining the types of cybercrime.
 
• Hence, The correct answer is **'Option 3,'**

Therefore, The correct title is **'Types of Cybercrime and their Effects.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• **Option (1) - "The global problem of Cybercrime"** is too broad. While the passage acknowledges cybercrime as a global issue, it spends more time explaining specific types and their effects.
 
• **Option (2) - "Cybersecurity measures for individuals and Organisations"** focuses only on a specific section of the passage. The passage also covers the types of cybercrime and their impact.
 
• **Option (4) - "The role of government in combatting cybercrime" **narrows down the topic too much. The passage mentions the role of government but places equal emphasis on individual and organizational measures, and explaining different cybercrimes.
